payload.summary: COUNTER (codex exec, model_reasoning_effort=low, read-only sandbox — quoted here because it ran CLI-less): DISAGREE with draft. Generate marked reference regions, do not parse hand-written tables: (1) shim generation already proves the registries are the source of truth — a verbs/workflows table is a pure registry projection, exactly what generation fits; (2) CI enforcement = run the generator in check mode and fail on diff, avoiding brittle markdown parsing AND catching uncommitted regenerations; (3) two-way exact description matching is needless lockstep churn — generate the descriptions instead; (4) keep docs/guide.md as contributor/reference docs, installed-repo onboarding stays nahel help + AGENTS.md section with README linking both; (5) mind aliases/hidden verbs/ordering, and draw an explicit manual-prose boundary the generator can never overwrite.
